question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing center midfielder, Bob is playing goalkeeper, Claire is playing left winger, Dave is playing right winger, Eve is playing right back, Fred is playing striker, and Gertrude is playing benchwarmer.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Fred and Dave trade positions. Then, Eve and Fred trade positions. Then, Fred and Bob trade positions. Then, Dave and Claire trade positions. Finally, Dave and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Fred is playing
Options:
(A) center midfielder
(B) goalkeeper
(C) left winger
(D) right winger
(E) right back
(F) striker
(G) benchwarmer
solution:
Player order in every row: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: center midfielder, goalkeeper, left winger, right winger, right back, striker, benchwarmer.
1. Eve ↔ Bob: center midfielder, right back, left winger, right winger, goalkeeper, striker, benchwarmer.
2. Eve ↔ Bob: center midfielder, goalkeeper, left winger, right winger, right back, striker, benchwarmer.
3. Fred ↔ Dave: center midfielder, goalkeeper, left winger, striker, right back, right winger, benchwarmer.
4. Eve ↔ Fred: center midfielder, goalkeeper, left winger, striker, right winger, right back, benchwarmer.
5. Fred ↔ Bob: center midfielder, right back, left winger, striker, right winger, goalkeeper, benchwarmer.
6. Dave ↔ Claire: center midfielder, right back, striker, left winger, right winger, goalkeeper, benchwarmer.
7. Dave ↔ Bob: center midfielder, left winger, striker, right back, right winger, goalkeeper, benchwarmer.
Fred is the goalkeeper, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
